notes.title: Early Access Build Version 0.2
notes.content:
Quality of life changes abound! Expect plenty of changes in the coming months! Until then we've done the following:

* Menu Update
  - Gameplay Settings section added.
  - Look and Turn sensitivity adjustments added.
  - Invert Axis control option added.

* Environmental/Gameplay Changes
  - Bug fixed where objects could be infinitely pushed away from player and through objects.
  - Improved Tutorial Room signage to make gameplay mechanics easier to understand.
  - Fixed a bug where the player could become stuck if colliding with certain objects.
  - Fixed certain areas where the player or other objects could accidentally clip out of bounds.
  - Replaced button/switch models to improve player experience.
  - Fixed a bug where the crane switches could be activated more than once.
  - Added visual cues to prevent confusion with certain puzzles.
  - Improved the consistency of certain scripted events.
  - Adjusted position of certain misplaced objects.
  - Temporarily removed the checkpoint control valves in the generator room.
  - Fixed and/or replaced incorrect or outdated textures on certain objects.
  - Fixed a bug where certain objects did not have correct collisions.
  - Updated Generator Room models and layout.
